title: Runs remain within a space window
statement: Let $M$ be a nondeterministic multi-tape Turing machine with Boolean input and state set $S$, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, and let $w$ be a choice word. If the space used by the run under $w$ from the initial configuration on $x$ is at most $s\in\mathbb{N}$, then for every $j\in\mathbb{N}$ the configuration reached under the prefix of $w$ of length $j$ lies in the window of radius $s$: every work-tape head position has absolute value at most $s$, and every cell at an integer position with absolute value greater than $s$ is blank on every work tape.
hypotheses_covered: machine with k work tapes, Boolean alphabet, and state set S
space used from the initial configuration on x is at most s
